question: What kind of endowed form is said to be acceptable despite having only small faults?
premises: A form endowed with all marks is described.
It may have only small faults.
Such a form is said to be possible.
inference: An image endowed with all marks may still be accepted if its faults are only small.
uncertainties: Exact reading and split of malpadoṣantuvā is uncertain from token alone.
plain_english: Endowed with all marks, it may have only small faults—or so it may be.
